sentences.en: Bria is a little more talkative than some of the other girls.
sentences.vi: Bria là một người ít nói hơn một số cô gái khác.

sentences.en: Bria was called Sasha when the dolls were first released.
sentences.vi: Bria được gọi là Sasha khi những con búp bê lần đầu tiên được phát hành.

sentences.en: Be you." to Bria's official profile proclaiming that she "sees the beauty in everything and everyone," the Moxie Girlz line tries to spread the message that girls should be proud of themselves and stay true to their dreams.
